title: A Progressive Evaluation Framework for Multicultural Analysis of Story Visualization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image story visualizations across English, Chinese, and Hindi contexts using human evaluators and an MLLM-as-Jury framework to score 'Cultural Appropriateness' based on cultural fidelity in apparel, infrastructure, facial features, and background objects.

Comparing the performance of multilingual text-to-image models on story prompts translated into English, Chinese, and Hindi, measuring disparities in generation quality through metrics like Cohesion, Semantic Consistency, and Object Presence.
